title: Determination of an anisotropic perturbation in elastic inverse scattering
summary: We consider a linearized inverse scattering problem for elastic waves. We prove that a fully anisotropic perturbation of the elastic parameters around an isotropic and homogeneous reference can be uniquely determined by (single-)scattered waves. We also give a quantitative stability estimate for an isotropic perturbation, and as a consequence a rigidity result is established.
